label: one-task FeatureBench fast Gemma 4 31B adapter canary
host_platform: macOS 25.5.0 Apple Silicon host; linux/amd64 task image under Docker Rosetta

qualification.controls: carried over from results/2026-08-01-v5-control-requalification.json (provider-independent); gold resolved, harmless nonempty applied-and-unresolved

cell.provider_amendment: v6 re-pin from SiliconFlow per results/2026-08-01-v6-provider-amendment.json; v4/pi comparisons carry a serving-stack confound

revision_3_observables.note: write-pressure prompt-note firings are not JSONL events; reconstructable from step history per the v5 registration record

agent.observed_failure: The agent executed 48 selected/48-accounted steps across 3 planning attempts (9 tree, 9 read, 18 write, 1 edit, 4 shell, 7 empty-action failures) and wrote /testbed/seaborn/algorithms.py 18 times through the sentinel transport with zero truncation: 56/56 responses finished stop (v4: 16/33 length), 0 response_truncated, 0 malformed_action step errors, no content_truncated recovery needed. It never ran the delivered tests and never emitted done, exhausting all three planning attempts in a rewrite loop; the final on-disk implementation was emitted as a 7351-byte patch. One OpenRouter ReadTimeout (host network change) was absorbed by the typed transport-error retry path.

pi_ablation_comparison.caveat: pi cells were served by SiliconFlow fp8; v6 by CoreWeave - serving-stack confound recorded in the v6 amendment

audit.original_audit_defect: canary_audit.py hardcoded SiliconFlow as the required provider instead of deriving it from the protocol; every CoreWeave-served token event and the v6 protocol itself were flagged
audit.corrected_audit_code_root: clean checkout of the execution revision 7025e9f (the code that ran at inference time)

interpretation: Under the preregistered issue-#17 rule this reads as: the JSON-string content transport was the whole story for patch production on this cell - v6 moves Gemma from empty patch to applied with 11/13 F2P (84.62%), exactly the pi-ablation ceiling with the identical two failing tests. The residual gap vs pi is completion signaling and efficiency (exhausted after 21.5 min / 56 calls vs pi complete in 83 s / 12 calls), which belongs to the plan/execute loop (commit-without-validate rewrite loop).
